To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the architecture-provided cache flushing operations do not meet the expectations and are ineffective to close the timing channels based on cache and branch predictor state.

(a) flushing the branch prediction unit does not close the covert channel, (b) flushing the translation look-aside buffer does nothing on Intel processors, and (c) flushing all caches is not effective in closing cache-based timing channels in both ARM and Intel processors.
